_what: Heavy on-device AI that runs in its own helper process instead of inside the app (computer/model-helper.mjs). A job is a row of `jobs`: `tiers`, best first, each naming the `runner` helper and the model `bundle` helper (both rows of computer/helper-runtimes.json, fetched on first use and checked against their pinned hash) and what the Mac needs to run it (min_memory_gb, optional arch). The most capable tier this Mac meets is used; none fits means the job says so in words. The runner is started with only the environment variables in `env`, in `timeout_seconds`, and is given the bundle's folder, the input path and the output path as arguments. Nothing is listed yet: a job and its tiers are rows added here once their helper rows are pinned, and with no rows the tool lists nothing and runs nothing.

words.unknown_job: There is no job named {id}. The jobs: {ids}.
words.no_jobs: No heavy AI job is set up on this Mac yet.
words.no_tier: This Mac ({memory_gb} GB memory, {arch}) is below the smallest tier of {id}, which needs {need_gb} GB.
words.needs_input: Give the path of the file to work on.
